Catalog search results now sort by filing title, so 'The Hobbit' lists under H. I couldn't run `npm test`, because Bash was denied for lack of an approval surface. I only checked the new expectations by hand, so please run `npm test`.

- **`lib/helpers/text.js`**: new `filingTitle(title)` strips a leading 'The', 'A' or 'An', case-insensitively. It only strips when whitespace follows, so 'Anthem' and 'Theory of Games' stay as written. A title that is only an article, such as 'The', stays whole.
- **`lib/catalog/search.js`**: `searchCatalog` compares filing titles. Titles that tie on filing title fall back to the full title, so the order is stable.
- **`test/catalog.test.js`**: I updated the existing sort test, since 'The Left Hand of Darkness' now comes before 'National Geographic'. I added a test for the edge cases ('The' on its own, 'Anthem', 'Theory…', a lowercase 'a Bee').

Only `searchCatalog` sorts catalog items by title. The other `localeCompare` sorts in `lib` order by id or date, so I left them alone.

I didn't commit anything.
